reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text supports it: p0030/p0035/p0039 are ordinary licence-scope use restrictions on the Work itself (no reverse engineering, no service bureau), not covenants limiting the businesses Sparkling may operate or the products it may buy or build.
p0133 is a mutual employee non-solicitation of one year, which falls outside this rule's scope (restrictive-covenant non-compete/field-of-use), so no NONCOMPETE deviation arises from it.

Consistent with the compliant status, no redline or counterparty comment was proposed, and the rendered text is unchanged from the original paragraphs — correct handling for internal evidence rather than a negotiation issue.
Deterministic check ('no open-ended compete restriction on Customer remains') is satisfied, corroborating the absence of a field-of-use or competing-products covenant binding us.
